body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A computer-implemented method of assessment of ischemia and related disorders, the method comprising:
receiving a patient-specific anatomic model including a portion of a patient's bowel;
receiving a patient physiological state, the physiological state being a state different from a resting state;
determining a blood flow demand of the portion of the patient's bowel modeled by the patient-specific anatomical model, based on a determined mass of the portion of the patient's bowel, amount of visceral vasculature and collateral pathway(s) a presence of collateralized vasculature supplying blood to the portion of patient's bowel modeled by the patient-specific anatomic model, and [[a]] the received physiological state of the patient;
calculating, using the determined blood flow demand, a blood flow characteristic of blood delivered to the portion of the patient's bowel using the determined blood flow demand and a value of microvascular resistance associated with the received physiological state;
receiving a threshold blood flow characteristic associated with the patient-specific anatomic model of the patient's bowel; and
generating and displaying (i) an assessment of blood supply adequacy defining an adequacy of blood supply to the patient's bowel, or (ii) a risk score defining a risk of disease of the patient's bowel, based on a comparison of the calculated blood flow characteristic to the received threshold blood flow characteristic.
2. (Previously Presented) The computer-implemented method of claim 1, wherein the blood flow characteristic includes one or more of blood pressure, flow rate, fractional flow reserve, or portal venous pressure.
3. (Currently Amended) The computer-implemented method of claim 1, further comprising:
determining the blood flow demand based on an allometric relationship between blood flow and the determined mass of the portion of the patient's bowel. wherein the threshold blood flow characteristic comprises an averaged blood flow characteristic.
4. (Currently Amended) The computer-implemented method of claim 3, further including:
subdividing the patient-specific anatomic model into one or more bowel regions;
determining an association between a vessel of the patient's vasculature and at least one bowel region of the one or more bowel regions; and
determining blood flow adequacy for one or more locations of the portion of the patient's bowel distal to the at least one bowel region, based on [[the]] a determined blood flow adequacy for the at least one bowel region.
5. (Previously Presented) The computer-implemented method of claim 1, further comprising:
calculating the blood flow characteristic using a fluid simulation or using blood flow characteristics associated with one or more other patients.
